candidats.titre: File:FEMA - 22422 - Photograph by Tom Hurd taken on 07-24-2004 in Iowa.jpg
candidats.description: Des Moines, Iowa, July 24, 2004 -- This tornado shelter for 400 campers at the Iowa State Fairgrounds outside Des Moines was completed in 2003. The 5,200 square-foot shelter is 100 feet long by 71 feet wide. When not in use as an emergency shelter, the large multi-purpose building is used by both the fairground staff and campers for restrooms, showers, a laundry area, offices, and meeting space. The shelter, funded through a $600,000 grant from FEMA's Hazard Mitigation Grant Program with the Iowa State Fair funding the remaining $150,000. candidats.titre: File:Behind the Scenes- Communications Facility at Osan Air Base (9593413).jpg
candidats.description: During a concrete placement at the new Communications Facility at Osan Air Base on Feb. 12, 2026, U.S. Army Corps of Engineers – Far East District (USACE FED) personnel and contractor teams visit project sites to ensure all work meets strict project standards such as inspecting the contractor placing concrete in real-time and watching the rebar panels being installed to reinforce structural walls, install welded tube steel and plywood forms, and secure formwork to prevent failure under pressure. (U.S. Army photo by Monique Freemon)
